methodology: Every signal is a reported price already published on the Chronicle (encyclopedia hall of fame, market briefing) or in the site's cited research trackers. Reported ranges, not live prices — the Chronicle does not scrape listings and publishes no price index. Signals are keyed to archive figure ids (<waveId>::<figureName>) so the Price Watch can compare a user's target against reported market data. Kinds: sold-band (reported eBay sold range), sold-avg (reported average over tracked sales), listing (a live listing or listing snapshot — not a sale), claimed (unverified claimed price, flagged single-source).
